class.name: Squad
class.brief_description: Command layer for tactical squad coordination.
class.description: Holds members, leader, objective, and tactical state. Aggregates member perceptions and issues orders. Decides WHAT; agents decide HOW.

method.name: add_member
method.description: Add an agent to the squad.

method.name: remove_member
method.description: Remove an agent from the squad.

method.name: get_member_count
method.description: Get the number of squad members.

method.name: set_leader
method.description: Set the squad leader agent ID.

method.name: get_leader_id
method.description: Get the squad leader agent ID.

method.name: update
method.description: Tick the squad: aggregate perceptions, evaluate tactical state, issue orders.
